question: Based on Table. c00eec81, Which game marked the first Monday night NFL matchup of the 2017 regular season, and where was it played?
answer: Green Bay Packers vs. Detroit Lions at Lambeau Field

text_evidence: During the early 1960s, NFL Commissioner Pete Rozelle envisioned the possibility of playing at least one game weekly during prime time that could be viewed by a greater television audience (while the NFL had scheduled Saturday night games on the DuMont Television Network in 1953 and 1954, poor ratings and the dissolution of DuMont led to those games being eliminated by the time CBS took over the rights in 1956). An early bid by the league in 1964 to play on Friday nights was soundly defeated, with critics charging that such telecasts would damage the attendance at high school football games. Undaunted, Rozelle decided to experiment with the concept of playing on Monday night, scheduling the Green Bay Packers and Detroit Lions for a game on September 28, 1964. While the game was not televised, it drew a sellout crowd of 59,203 spectators to Tiger Stadium, the largest crowd ever to watch a professional football game in Detroit up to that point.

multi_choice_QA_options: New York Giants vs. Detroit Lions at MetLife Stadium
Arizona Cardinals vs. Detroit Lions at Ford Field
Pittsburgh Steelers vs. Detroit Lions at Ford Field
Green Bay Packers vs. Detroit Lions at Lambeau Field

meta_data.original_question: Which game marked the first Monday night NFL matchup of the 2017 regular season, and where was it played?

question: Based on Table. f966090c, What was the filming location for most of the scenes of the 3D monster horror film produced by Universal-International, and how is this location associated with the entertainment industry?

text_evidence: Ben Chapman portrayed the Gill-man for the majority of the scenes shot at Universal City, California. Many of the on-top of the water scenes were filmed at Rice Creek near Palatka, Florida. The costume made it impossible for Chapman to sit for the 14 hours of each day that he wore it, and it overheated easily, so he stayed in the back lot's lake, often requesting to be hosed down. He also could not see very well while wearing the headpiece, which caused him to scrape Julie Adams' head against the wall when carrying her in the grotto scenes. Ricou Browning played the Gill-Man in the underwater shots, which were filmed by the second unit in Wakulla Springs, Florida.

question: Based on Fig. 8f99ed81, the text, which metrics experienced a "significant delay in the health response system" according to the public health protocol time targets and specified criteria?
answer: Metrics 1 and 3 failed to meet the targets.

text_evidence: Public health protocols state that for the pandemic response to be evaluated as effective, at least 80% of cases must meet the time targets specified in each of the metrics shown in the charts. The metrics are: (1) the time between symptom onset and receipt of swab by the lab, which should be under 48 hours; (2) the time between receipt of the swab test result by the lab and notification of the case, which should take no more than 24 hours; and (3) the time between notification of a case and tracing of close contacts, which should also occur within 48 hours. Failure to reach these targets on any metric is considered a significant delay in the health response system.

multi_choice_QA_options: None of the metrics failed to meet the targets
Metrics 2 and 3 failed to meet the targets
Metrics 1 and 3 failed to meet the targets.
Metrics 1 and 2 failed to meet the targets

question: Based on Table. 544cca09, Which city, ranked fourth globally for liveability in 2015, serves as the setting for exterior shots of the store whose original signage inspired that of Kim's Convenience?

text_evidence: Interior scenes at the store, Handy Car Rental and home are shot at Showline Studios at 901 Lake Shore Boulevard East, where an exact replica of Mimi Variety, the model for the store, has been recreated. The studio is also used as the exterior of the car rental business. One episode was shot in Koreatown at Bloor and Christie Streets. The long established "Mimi Variety" store at 252 Queen Street East is used for exterior shots and as the model for the interior set built in the studio. While the signage has been adjusted, the "Kim's Convenience" sign uses the same red and green lettering and all other sections, such as the "7 DAYS A WEEK", are the original signage of Mimi Variety. The producers also painted a mural on an exterior wall, mostly seen in the credit sequence and for stock transitional shots as well as for promotional shots. The owners of the store have retained the new signage although the business has not officially changed its name.
